items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Petrillo in context of union history; Interviewee responds with 'Right' confirming general knowledge of the events, but no personal interaction is described.

ctx.x: Well, I mean, their scales were lower than 10's, and they were supposed to be having the same scales.
Well, the story is that Petrillo and Gray were both presidents of the respective locals for many years.
